title: Fix: every hour shows every event
hints: After `buckets[9].append(...)`, check `buckets[0] is buckets[9]`. What does that tell you?
`[[]] * 24` doesn't make 24 lists. It makes **one** empty list and puts 24 references to it in the outer list, so appending through any index changes the same list.
Build a new inner list for every hour: `buckets: list[list[str]] = [[] for _ in range(24)]`.
